description: A MATLAB-based GUI for Performance-based Tornado Engineering (PBTE) of a Monopole, Vertical Structure with Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Luca Caracoglia, Northeastern University (northeastern.edu). The PBTEANN application is a MATLAB®-based graphical user interface (GUI) that uses Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) to expedite the performance-based tornado engineering (PBTE) assessment of a monopole, vertical structure subjected to wind loads from simulated tornadoes of various intensities and sizes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-g7fe-1k09. Keywords: Performance-based Tornado Engineering (PBTE), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Surrogate Modeling, Performance-based Wind Engineering (PBWE). Published 2020-05-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
